name: CardNav-TS-TW
blurb: Navigation bar expands to reveal card-based submenu with staggered entrance.
description: A GSAP-driven mega menu that animates from a 60px bar to full height on click. Cards slide up and fade in with stagger. Responsive: calculates dynamic height on mobile, maintains fixed height on desktop. Includes logo and icon-based links.
use_when: You need a sophisticated navigation menu with grouped card-based categories.
avoid_when: Simple linear navigation — this is optimized for multi-level hierarchies.
a11y: Hamburger icon toggles menu. Links have ariaLabel. Resize events update height. No keyboard navigation beyond clicks.
